protocol: Validate complete required ordinary purchase fields, six recognized old statuses, numeric quantities/prices, unique identifiers, versions, known scalar fields and barcode details before writing. PCS 草稿 is not an ordinary record in this old key.
Reject embedded data/blob content, unknown attachment fields, missing/mismatched Blob entities or ownership; preserve raw.
Normalize comparison ignoring only _baseVersion and _pmsBaseVersion; preserve all business values and business version fields.
In one existing pmsTx transaction read all old-record targets, versions, attachment ownership/entities and stable raw-hash receipt before enqueuing any put. Conflict anywhere aborts the batch.

Equivalent target rows are skipped without puts or version increments. Missing records, fresh managed versions, supported attachment references, one operation log and one stable receipt are committed together.
Only after transaction complete publish operation log. Independently read every target record, version, attachment and migration receipt/log again.
Recheck original raw equality immediately before removing only this exact LS key. Read errors, changed raw and removal failure retain cleanup-pending, never imply an uncommitted purchase write.
Retry identical raw uses its SHA-256 operation ID and existing receipt; no duplicate order/version/log. Other LS keys, shared Blobs/references and retired physical sources are untouched.
businessBoundary: No PCS draft or unknown status is silently mapped. Ordinary purchase snapshots may retain historic material identity; this does not recreate retired catalog masters. No attachment byte conversion or source cleanup of unknown files is attempted.
storageAtomicityBoundary: Records/versions/necessary attachment ownership/log/receipt are atomic within PMS IDB. LS cleanup is separate and verified; UI must require old pages closed because LS and IDB have no joint transaction. No cross-store atomicity is claimed.
